QuestInfo.name: The Suspicious Secretary
QuestInfo.0: You should break down all the information you got from #p2153000#.
QuestInfo.1:
First, the watchmen are unimportant. They have no idea what the Black Wings are doing.

Second, the Black Wing officers are all over Maple World collecting resources, though it's more likely they are after Seal Stones.

Third, the founder of the Black Wings is collecting an incredible amount of energy from the mine nearby. 

You're on a wild goose chase unless you can find something more substantial. Follow your nose to Secretary #b#p2154002##k, but be careful.
QuestInfo.2: Secretary #p2154002# was a beautiful lady with auburn hair and a sweet voice, but there's something very dangerous about her...

0.0: I need to break all this down...
0.1: First, the Black Wings watchmen are just everyday people. The know nothing about their employer, only that they have to keep doing their jobs or bad things start happening. Fighting them would be nothing but cruel.
0.2: Second, Black Wing officers are collecting resources from all over Maple World. If they're trying to free the Black Mage, that could be Seal Stones.
0.3: Third, the founder of the Black Wings is inside the mines right now, trying to extract an incredible amount of energy from #m310000000#. That part is strange...
0.4: The only thing left for me to do is find an officer. That means I need to talk to Secretary #b#p2154002##k and give her a bit of the old Phantom charm.

yes.0: Maybe I'm heading in the wrong direction here.  These people are just no use, but I can't turn back now or my cover will be blown. I don't know what #p2154002# does, but I'll go meet her.

no.0: I do hope the secretary can speed this along. I'm getting tired of dodging around after small fries.

1.0: Hello to you. I don't believe we've met yet, but I feel like I've seen you somewhere before. You have a very memorable face.
